purpose: Fictional round-trip and one-way packages for the Lyon-Alger reference example of the 3H plan (I4, plan section 6.2): route admissibility, package legs and route-aware negotiation keys.
limitations: Suppliers, flights, prices and capacities are fictional; nothing here is availability, a schedule or a commercial offer.

Written from rules fixed in advance (scope review I4, section 5): list prices per seat for the whole package, private floors at 70 percent of the list price, per-seat prices non-increasing with group size, capacities such that H2 holds with the largest admitted request (20 seats) plus the demand pool v2.
Frozen by this manifest before the first planning run (I4-B) and never tuned afterwards; any edit requires updating catalog_sha256 here, and the loader refuses a mismatch.
Seller floors are private parameters of the simulated seller; they are used only by the P3 negotiation simulator and are never shown to travellers.
